exam.title: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Azure administration or development, Git and source-control workflows, CI/CD, testing, identity and security, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and experience implementing both GitHub and Azure DevOps solutions.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Design and implement processes and communications
Design and implement a source control strategy
Design and implement build and release pipelines
Develop a security and compliance plan

review.notes: All five weighted July 27, 2026 objective groups and every published subobjective are mapped to an end-to-end work-to-production evidence model, comparisons, failure modes, three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 24 original knowledge checks. All 40 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries; one Udemy page returned HTTP 403 and is treated as access-blocked rather than missing. The guide covers both GitHub and Azure DevOps, including Git/branch/repository scaling, package and test strategy, reusable YAML, hosted and self-hosted execution, progressive delivery, database compatibility, IaC and desired state, identity federation, security scanning, OpenTelemetry, KQL and delivery-system metrics. It explicitly records the September 30, 2027 Azure Automation State Configuration retirement and the July 1, 2027 applicable Azure DevOps WIF issuer retirement with their current transition destinations.

findings.title: Merge queue requires checks on a different commit
findings.evidence: merge_group/external queue branches must produce required checks.
findings.recommendation: Add trigger/commit boundary and stalled queue diagnosis.
findings.resolution: Add trigger/commit boundary and stalled queue diagnosis.

findings.title: View permissions are an additional package access path
findings.evidence: View access can download without direct feed access; empty selected list inherits.

findings.title: Promotion does not support demotion
findings.evidence: Publish to base feed and promote existing version; no demotion rollback.
findings.recommendation: Separate immutable version selection from view promotion.
findings.resolution: Separate immutable version selection from view promotion.

findings.title: GitHub JavaScript actions no longer use Node20
findings.evidence: September23 Node24 change ends temporary insecure opt-out.
findings.recommendation: Add action/runner migration scope, distinct from app runtime.
findings.resolution: Add action/runner migration scope, distinct from app runtime.

findings.title: Workflow policies add actor/event controls and a dated default rollout
findings.evidence: GA targeting and November2 affected-public-repository pull_request_target enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Add plan-scoped policy review without blanket private-repo claims.
findings.resolution: Add plan-scoped policy review without blanket private-repo claims.

findings.title: Cache writes are a separate trust boundary
findings.evidence: Explicit write mode can override low-trust read default; called workflow cannot increase caller access.
findings.recommendation: Add cache permission decision and poisoning boundary.
findings.resolution: Add cache permission decision and poisoning boundary.

findings.title: A custom condition replaces default success requirements
findings.evidence: Branch-only conditions can permit downstream work after failure.
findings.recommendation: Add success/branch composition and evaluation-time lesson.
findings.resolution: Add success/branch composition and evaluation-time lesson.

findings.title: What-if completeness and validation depth must be inspected
findings.evidence: ProviderNoRbac/Template levels and short-circuit diagnostics differ.
findings.recommendation: Avoid treating empty output as successful deployment or permission proof.
findings.resolution: Avoid treating empty output as successful deployment or permission proof.

findings.title: Actions retention scope expands October1
findings.evidence: Checks, runs and statuses expire with configured retention, including relevant third-party metadata.
findings.recommendation: Add archive/rollback-evidence review and dated follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add archive/rollback-evidence review and dated follow-up.

findings.title: Entra membership does not confer Azure DevOps authorization
findings.evidence: Access level, DevOps groups/resource permissions, per-org licenses and cleanup required.
findings.recommendation: Separate Azure/Entra permissions from DevOps resource authorization.
findings.resolution: Separate Azure/Entra permissions from DevOps resource authorization.

findings.title: Issuer retirement excludes specified clouds/application types
findings.evidence: July1,2027 applies to public-cloud single-tenant and managed-identity connections.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped inventory and conversion validation before old trust removal.
findings.resolution: Add scoped inventory and conversion validation before old trust removal.

findings.title: Default CodeQL setup is not universal PR/build coverage
findings.evidence: Default branch, supported languages and no custom build; advanced covers other requirements.
findings.recommendation: Explain selection and agent/concurrency planning, using current GA release.
findings.resolution: Explain selection and agent/concurrency planning, using current GA release.

findings.title: Raw KQL counts can misstate sampled traffic
findings.evidence: itemCount weights estimate totals; retained-row percentiles remain sample percentiles.
findings.recommendation: Revise query and teach sampling example/unsampled release signals.
findings.resolution: Revise query and teach sampling example/unsampled release signals.

findings.title: Public DevOps projects will require authentication
findings.evidence: New public creation retired; existing2027 conversion affects links, packages and pipelines.
findings.recommendation: Add dependency inventory and banner-date follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add dependency inventory and banner-date follow-up.
